final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, t.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
